verification_categories_derived_from_spe: Device speed identification — D+ vs D- pull-up.
USB Reset (SE0 ≥ 10 ms) returns device to Default state.
Bus enumeration sequence — descriptor reads + SET_ADDRESS + SET_CONFIGURATION.
Standard device requests — all 11 standard requests.
Data toggle alternation + SETUP-forces-DATA0 + STALL preserves toggle.
Bulk transfer at each valid max packet size.
Interrupt transfer at each polling interval.
Isochronous transfer with no retry on error.
Split transactions (Start-Split + Complete-Split) for HS-hub-to-FS/LS bridging.
VBUS power budget compliance per device class.
CRC-5 + CRC-16 error injection and detection.
HS test modes (Test_J / Test_K / Test_SE0_NAK / Test_Packet / Test_Force_Enable).
fields.notes: USB 2.0 does not include a formal verification plan; the USB-IF maintains a Compliance Program with electrical, protocol, and interoperability test suites. Categories above are derived from Chapters 5-11 of the spec.
